AFML Ch.17 Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller SADF_t (s.17.4.2, p.253) on log(Close): supremum of the ADF t-values of beta in Delta y_t = alpha + beta y_t-1 + gamma_1 Delta y_t-1 + delta t + eps_t (Snippets 17.1-17.4, 'ct', 1 lag, minSL 10) over backward-expanding start points within the 50 log closes ending at the current bar, computed at every bar (D061); the 50-bar window is a registered deviation from the book's whole-sample start points (D062). See shared/features/afml_ch17_structural_breaks.py.
AFML Ch.17 Quantile ADF centrality Q_t,q (s.17.4.2.4, p.255): the q = 0.95 quantile (numpy linear) of the same set s_t of ADF t-values SADF_ct_50 takes the supremum of (D063).
AFML Ch.17 Quantile ADF dispersion Q._t,q,v = Q_t,q+v - Q_t,q-v (s.17.4.2.4, p.255), q = 0.95, v = 0.025, on the same s_t as SADF_ct_50 (D063).
AFML Ch.17 Conditional ADF centrality C_t,q (s.17.4.2.5, p.256): mean of the values of s_t at or above Q_t,q (q = 0.95; empirical f), same s_t as SADF_ct_50 (D063).
AFML Ch.17 Conditional ADF dispersion C._t,q (s.17.4.2.5, p.256): standard deviation of the values of s_t at or above Q_t,q (q = 0.95), same s_t as SADF_ct_50 (D063).

AFML Ch.17 Chu-Stinchcombe-White CUSUM on log-price levels (s.17.3.2, p.251): sup over n < t of S_n,t = (y_t - y_n) / (sigma_t sqrt(t - n)), sigma_t^2 = mean squared log-close change, on the 50 log closes ending at the current bar (D064).
AFML Ch.17 Chu-Stinchcombe-White CUSUM (s.17.3.2) on -log(Close) = log(1/Close) (exercise 17.5: the one-sided test needs the reciprocal to see bursts); same window and sigma as CSW_Up_50 (D064).

AFML Ch.17 sub/super-martingale test SM-Poly1 (s.17.4.3, pp.259-261): y_t = alpha + gamma t + beta t^2 on raw Close, fitted by OLS on every sample of 11-50 closes ending at the current bar, time counted from the sample start; SMT_t = sup over start points t0 of |beta| / (sigma_beta (t - t0)^phi), phi = 0 (unpenalised) (D064).

AFML Ch.17 sub/super-martingale test SM-Poly1 (s.17.4.3, pp.259-261): y_t = alpha + gamma t + beta t^2 on raw Close, fitted by OLS on every sample of 11-50 closes ending at the current bar, time counted from the sample start; SMT_t = sup over start points t0 of |beta| / (sigma_beta (t - t0)^phi), phi = 0.5 (D064).

AFML Ch.17 sub/super-martingale test SM-Poly1 (s.17.4.3, pp.259-261): y_t = alpha + gamma t + beta t^2 on raw Close, fitted by OLS on every sample of 11-50 closes ending at the current bar, time counted from the sample start; SMT_t = sup over start points t0 of |beta| / (sigma_beta (t - t0)^phi), phi = 1 (D064).

AFML Ch.17 sub/super-martingale test SM-Poly2 (s.17.4.3, pp.259-261): log y_t = alpha + gamma t + beta t^2, fitted by OLS on every sample of 11-50 closes ending at the current bar, time counted from the sample start; SMT_t = sup over start points t0 of |beta| / (sigma_beta (t - t0)^phi), phi = 0 (unpenalised) (D064).

notes: Feature schema declared before runtime build_features implementation.
This is a broad Tier 1 candidate universe inspired by V1 XAUUSD trend feature factory, not a final selected model input list.
All declared features are live-safe from verified asset-level closed standard_quote_tick OHLC bars.
Tier 2 FFD/regime features are intentionally deferred until V2 shared runtime modules exist.
Selected features must later be produced by iterative feature surgery and saved in artifacts/selected_features.json.
If a selected feature is missing live, fix runtime.py/schema; do not patch the dashboard.
